lyrics.ja: 天気予報　晴れのち雨マーク
lyrics.romaji: Tenki Yohou Hare Nochi Ame Maaku
lyrics.en: The forecast shows clear skies then rain
lyrics.zh: 天氣預報，晴後雨的標誌

lyrics.ja: 「傘は邪魔だ　傘は邪魔だ　DADADANDAN」
lyrics.romaji: 「Kasa ha Jama Da Kasa ha Jama Da DADADANDAN」
lyrics.en: "Umbrellas are a nuisance, umbrellas are a nuisance—DADADANDAN"
lyrics.zh: 「雨傘好礙事，雨傘好礙事，DADADANDAN」

lyrics.ja: 財布さえもワンチャンいらない時代
lyrics.romaji: Saifu Sae mo Wanchan Iranai Jidai
lyrics.en: An era where you might not even need a wallet
lyrics.zh: 連錢包都可能不需要的時代

lyrics.ja: 「傘は邪魔だ　傘は邪魔だ　DADADAN」
lyrics.romaji: 「Kasa ha Jama Da Kasa ha Jama Da DADADAN」
lyrics.en: "Umbrellas are a nuisance, umbrellas are a nuisance—DADADAN"
lyrics.zh: 「雨傘好礙事，雨傘好礙事，DADADAN」

lyrics.ja: 右手にはスマホ　左手にカバン
lyrics.romaji: Migite ni ha Sumaho Hidarite ni Kaban
lyrics.en: Smartphone in my right hand, bag in my left
lyrics.zh: 右手拿手機，左手拿包包

lyrics.ja: 腕にかけて行くしかない (Nai)
lyrics.romaji: Ude ni Kakete Iku Shika Nai (Nai)
lyrics.en: I have no choice but to hang it on my arm (No choice)
lyrics.zh: 只能掛在手臂上（沒辦法）

lyrics.ja: 歩くたび弁慶の泣き所が泣く
lyrics.romaji: Aruku Tabi Benkei no Nakidokoro ga Naku
lyrics.en: Every step, my shin cries out
lyrics.zh: 每走一步，小腿骨就哀嚎

lyrics.ja: 嗚呼　嫌だ～
lyrics.romaji: Aa Iya Da
lyrics.en: Ah, I hate this
lyrics.zh: 啊啊，好討厭～

lyrics.ja: 床に (おけない)　立てて (おけない)
lyrics.romaji: Yuka ni (Okenai) Tatete (Okenai)
lyrics.en: Can't put it on the floor, can't stand it up
lyrics.zh: 不能放地上，不能立著

lyrics.ja: 傘立てで迷子は Everytime
lyrics.romaji: Kasa Date de Maigo ha Everytime
lyrics.en: Lost in the umbrella stand every time
lyrics.zh: 在傘架裡迷路，每次都是

lyrics.ja: ポツポツ (Fu)　降り出す (Fu Fu)
lyrics.romaji: Potsupotsu (Fu) Furidasu (Fu Fu)
lyrics.en: Drip-drop (fu), it starts to rain (fu fu)
lyrics.zh: 滴滴答答（呼）開始下雨（呼呼）

lyrics.ja: 水も滴りたくはない
lyrics.romaji: Mizu mo Shitataritaku ha Nai
lyrics.en: I don't want to be dripping wet either
lyrics.zh: 也不想滴著水

lyrics.ja: やっぱり傘しかない　傘傘様様(かさかさまさま)
lyrics.romaji: Yappari Kasa Shika Nai Kasa Kasa Samasama
lyrics.en: After all, there's nothing but an umbrella—praise be to the umbrella
lyrics.zh: 果然還是只能靠雨傘，雨傘大人萬歲

lyrics.ja: 傘なしじゃびしょ濡れ
lyrics.romaji: Kasa Nashi ja Bishonure
lyrics.en: Without an umbrella, I'd be soaked
lyrics.zh: 沒傘就會全身濕透

lyrics.ja: おしゃれな感じの傘で赤坂
lyrics.romaji: Oshare na Kanji no Kasa de Akasaka
lyrics.en: Through Akasaka with a stylish umbrella
lyrics.zh: 撐著時尚的傘走過赤坂

lyrics.ja: カッパよりもアンブレラ
lyrics.romaji: Kappa yori mo Anburera
lyrics.en: Better than a raincoat—umbrella
lyrics.zh: 比起雨衣，不如撐傘

lyrics.ja: 靴下くらい濡れたっていいさ
lyrics.romaji: Kutsushita Kurai Nureta tte Ii sa
lyrics.en: It's fine if my socks get a little wet
lyrics.zh: 不過是襪子濕了也沒關係

lyrics.ja: 傘賛歌
lyrics.romaji: Kasa Sanka
lyrics.en: An umbrella anthem
lyrics.zh: 雨傘讚歌

lyrics.ja: 電車の床　作る水たまり
lyrics.romaji: Densha no Yuka Tsukuru Mizutamari
lyrics.en: On the train floor, it makes a puddle
lyrics.zh: 在電車地板上形成水窪

lyrics.ja: 「傘の所為だ　傘の所為だ　DADADANDAN」
lyrics.romaji: 「Kasa no Sei Da Kasa no Sei Da DADADANDAN」
lyrics.en: "It's the umbrella's fault, the umbrella's fault—DADADANDAN"
lyrics.zh: 「都是雨傘害的，都是雨傘害的，DADADANDAN」

lyrics.ja: ビルの前で浴びる水しぶき
lyrics.romaji: Biru no Mae de Abiru Mizushibuki
lyrics.en: Splashed with water in front of the building
lyrics.zh: 在大樓前被水花濺到

lyrics.ja: 「傘の所為だ　傘の所為だ　DADADAN」
lyrics.romaji: 「Kasa no Sei Da Kasa no Sei Da DADADAN」
lyrics.en: "It's the umbrella's fault, the umbrella's fault—DADADAN"
lyrics.zh: 「都是雨傘害的，都是雨傘害的，DADADAN」

lyrics.ja: 腕が (だるい)　電話 (出れない)
lyrics.romaji: Ude ga (Darui) Denwa (Derenai)
lyrics.en: My arm is tired, I can't answer the phone
lyrics.zh: 手臂好痠，沒法接電話

lyrics.ja: たたむとき濡れるのしょうがない？
lyrics.romaji: Tatamu Toki Nureru no Shou ga Nai?
lyrics.en: Getting wet when folding it—can't be helped?
lyrics.zh: 收傘時弄濕也是沒辦法的事？

lyrics.ja: もう一回降る (Fu)　ザーザー級 (Fu Fu)
lyrics.romaji: Mou Ikkai Furu (Fu) Zaazaa Kyuu (Fu Fu)
lyrics.en: It rains once more (fu), downpour-level (fu fu)
lyrics.zh: 又下起雨（呼），傾盆大雨等級（呼呼）

lyrics.ja: 雨宿りの恋なんてない
lyrics.romaji: Amayadori no Koi Nante Nai
lyrics.en: There's no romance in taking shelter from rain
lyrics.zh: 躲雨時哪會有什麼戀情

lyrics.ja: 強い風吹けば　傘が逆さま
lyrics.romaji: Tsuyoi Kaze Fukeba Kasa ga Sakasama
lyrics.en: When a strong wind blows, the umbrella flips inside out
lyrics.zh: 強風一吹，雨傘就翻面

lyrics.ja: ありがとうアンブレラ
lyrics.romaji: Arigatou Anburera
lyrics.en: Thank you, umbrella
lyrics.zh: 謝謝你，雨傘

lyrics.ja: 万能なようで万能じゃないんだ
lyrics.romaji: Bannou na You de Bannou ja Nai n Da
lyrics.en: It seems all-purpose, but it isn't
lyrics.zh: 看似萬能，其實並非萬能

lyrics.ja: 傘賛歌
lyrics.romaji: Kasa Sanka
lyrics.en: An umbrella anthem
lyrics.zh: 雨傘讚歌

lyrics.ja: いい加減に進化して　身軽にいかせて
lyrics.romaji: Iikagen ni Shinka Shite Migaru ni Ikasete
lyrics.en: Just evolve already and let me travel light
lyrics.zh: 快點進化吧，讓我輕便出行

lyrics.ja: 四千年間変わらない (Nai)
lyrics.romaji: Yonsen Nenkan Kawaranai (Nai)
lyrics.en: Unchanged for four thousand years (No)
lyrics.zh: 四千年來不變（不）

lyrics.ja: 忘れたらコンビニ　予定外の出費
lyrics.romaji: Wasuretara Konbini Yoteigai no Shuppi
lyrics.en: If I forget it—convenience store, an unplanned expense
lyrics.zh: 忘了帶就去超商，計畫外的開銷

lyrics.ja: 嗚呼　嫌だ～
lyrics.romaji: Aa Iya Da
lyrics.en: Ah, I hate this
lyrics.zh: 啊啊，好討厭～

lyrics.ja: だけど傘しかない　傘傘様様(かさかさまさま)
lyrics.romaji: Dakedo Kasa Shika Nai Kasa Kasa Samasama
lyrics.en: But there's nothing but an umbrella—praise be to the umbrella
lyrics.zh: 但還是只能靠雨傘，雨傘大人萬歲

lyrics.ja: 傘なしじゃびしょ濡れ
lyrics.romaji: Kasa Nashi ja Bishonure
lyrics.en: Without an umbrella, I'd be soaked
lyrics.zh: 沒傘就會全身濕透

lyrics.ja: 街中カラフル　傘、傘、傘さ
lyrics.romaji: Machijuu Karafuru Kasa, Kasa, Kasa sa
lyrics.en: The whole town is colorful—umbrellas, umbrellas, umbrellas
lyrics.zh: 街上五彩繽紛，傘、傘、傘

lyrics.ja: 絵になるねアンブレラ
lyrics.romaji: E ni Naru ne Anburera
lyrics.en: Umbrellas make quite a picture
lyrics.zh: 雨傘真上鏡呢

lyrics.ja: なんだかんだ手放せないや
lyrics.romaji: Nandakanda Tebanasenai ya
lyrics.en: For better or worse, I can't let it go
lyrics.zh: 說來說去還是離不開它

lyrics.ja: 傘賛歌
lyrics.romaji: Kasa Sanka
lyrics.en: An umbrella anthem
lyrics.zh: 雨傘讚歌
